content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: catalog-config-alert -> model-catalog mapping mismatch detected for model 'open-m/zen-13b' on region-us-west. Error spike observed in tokenizer pipeline; automated retries increasing latency. PD: PD-654321

pagerduty: page PD-654321 routed to on-call group 'eng-oncall'

maria-chen: ack — I'm on it, grabbing the runbook.

jake-wang: +1, seeing a surge of 502/500 with logs showing 'tokenizer mismatch: expected bpe-v1, got bpe-v2' from inference-service. Those routes are failing prefix tokenization.

oliver: any recent catalog promotions? I can check promotion history.

maria-chen: yes, there was an automated promotion 12m ago by `autopromote-bot` that moved rev r20260311-17 -> r20260312-01 as default.

jake-wang: that aligns. New rev appears to include an embedded tokenizer id that runtime doesn't accept for this model variant. Might be a mapping key mismatch in catalog metadata.

maria-chen: triage plan: 1) pin traffic back to previous default rev 2) patch catalog entry to explicit tokenizer override 3) throttle retries and enable fallback variant routing. Doing step 1 now.

maria-chen: running rollback pin: ```bash
# pin catalog default for open-m/zen-13b
rwctl catalog pin --model open-m/zen-13b --revision r20260311-17 --reason "emergency rollback: tokenizer mismatch"
```

incident-bot: Action logged: catalog.pin requested by maria-chen (job id cj-7721).

jake-wang: while rollback proceeds, I'll prep a cache reload and a temporary routing rule to funnel traffic to 'zen-13b-fallback' variant. Command to add route: ```bash
rwctl route update --route /v1/generate --model open-m/zen-13b --variant zen-13b-fallback --weight 100
```

tara-support: customer-impact summary: Support thread shows ~8 customers with elevated latency and ~3 customers seeing 5xxs in last 15m. No PII exposed; main impact is degraded availability and higher retry counts.

oliver: promotion job logs (snippet): ```
[2026-03-12T00:12:05Z] autopromote-bot: promoting open-m/zen-13b rev r20260312-01
[2026-03-12T00:12:07Z] catalog-service: applied metadata {tokenizer: bpe-v2}
[2026-03-12T00:12:09Z] runtime: started serving rev r20260312-01
[2026-03-12T00:12:20Z] runtime: ERROR tokenizer mismatch for request id req-42: expected bpe-v1
```

jake-wang: confirmed rollback has reached control plane; I'm triggering runtime cache invalidation across us-west pods: ```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n rw-us-west --selector=app=inference-runtime
```

maria-chen: temporarily reduced retry policy for affected routes to avoid thundering herd: `rwctl config set --route /v1/generate --retries 1`

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-654321 acknowledged by maria-chen.

oncall-rotations: tagging oncall SRE to monitor disk and mem while restart happens.

jake-wang: logs after restart: seeing successful tokenization on pinned rev, error rate dropped from ~7% to ~0.3% for the route. Latency also returning to baseline.

maria-chen: good. I'm going to patch the catalog entry to make tokenizer explicit on the safe rev so autopromote won't reintroduce implicit tokenizer mapping. Patch command: ```bash
rwctl catalog patch --model open-m/zen-13b --revision r20260311-17 --set metadata.tokenizer=bpe-v1 --reason "explicit tokenizer to avoid autopromote ambiguity"
```

oliver: adding a temporary guard to promotion pipeline to fail if tokenizer key changes without approval. I'll open a PR for autopromote config and add a check in the pipeline.

tara-support: continued customer comms: notifying top affected accounts and offering mitigation details. No billing impacts expected.

maria-chen: monitoring 10m windows for error count and SLO hit. If stable, will close PD and file postmortem.

jake-wang: assigning postmortem owner: jake-wang. I'll include reproduction steps, root cause (autopromote changing tokenizer metadata), mitigation (pin + explicit tokenization + pipeline guard), and next steps (tests and alerts).

maria-chen: status update: 20m after rollback — errors back to baseline, retries normalized, customer reports improving. Keeping page open until we confirm no regression.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-654321 is on status MONITORING (acknowledged).

maria-chen: closing the immediate on-call loop: will handoff to SRE shift for overnight watch. Handoff notes: pinned rev r20260311-17, fallback routing in place, autopromote check in flight, postmortem assigned.

oncall-rotations: handoff acked — thanks.

maria-chen: marking follow-ups: (1) autopromote pipeline guard PR (oliver) (2) improve catalog validation to detect tokenizer-rev mismatches (jake) (3) runbook update to include explicit tokenizer step (maria).

jake-wang: final: closing PD once support confirms top accounts report recovered.

tara-support: confirm — support threads show recovery for affected customers. No escalations pending.

maria-chen: closing the page in 30m if metrics hold. Good job team :thumbsup:

-- 45 minutes later --

maria-chen: metrics look stable for 1h. Closing PD now and creating incident ticket INC-2026-0312-zen-tokenizer for postmortem.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-654321 resolved by maria-chen.

jake-wang: creating postmortem draft and will link remediation PRs.

oliver: noted for on-call retro.

tara-support: adding a short customer-facing blurb for account teams.
